payload.title: Prevent clipped living-report overview cells
payload.description:
As a stakeholder, I want the living-report workbook overview to display its complete labels and values, so that the cover sheet is readable without manual resizing.

Feature: Readable optimization workbook overview

Scenario: Open a generated living-report workbook
  Given a stakeholder workbook with lifecycle metadata and a plain-language summary
  When the workbook is opened or rendered at its default layout
  Then the complete overview headings, labels, and values are visible without clipping
  And every other stakeholder sheet remains readable

Out of scope: changing report evidence, adding resources, or altering optimization decisions.
